ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the ventral surface with a high-intensity (white) pixel ratio of approximately 0.15:1, primarily occurring in circular scar regions and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark (black) background across both lobes; high-contrast white circular ring-shaped blobs (rosettes) scattered non-uniformly; localized high-intensity pixel clusters at distal tips; dark pigmentation dominates the inner and central lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees; depth of depression is clearly delineated by the convergence of the inner lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular low-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; high-frequency jaggedness and pixel-amplitude variations at the distal tips due to biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave upper boundary sweeping outwards and slightly upwards from the central notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial distribution of circular white ring-shaped pixel clusters (rosettes) across both lobes; clusters vary in diameter and are most concentrated in the mid-lateral regions of the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacle colonization) on the upper distal edges of both lobes, creating a highly irregular, jagged pixel-boundary profile at the outer tips.
